meta.notes: Similarweb (similarweb.com/top-websites/india) was the requested primary source but refused connections from this environment (TLS close on every attempt); Semrush per-category lists were used instead. rank_hint uses Semrush overall rank when present, else best Semrush category rank, else Ahrefs organic-search rank, else empty. Excluded: adult, piracy/movie-leak, betting/satta, CDN, ad and tracking domains.
